research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Talus Bio is developing methods for drug discovery targeting nuclear and chromatin bound proteins. Extraction of nuclear and chromatin-bound proteins using volatile salts describes solutions and buffers that enable efficient protein extraction compatible with mass spectrometry. Lectin-assisted isolation of mammalian cell nuclei details solid supports for isolating nuclei, while Methods for identifying reactive functional cysteines in nuclear proteins focuses on mapping reactive sites. Together, these support nuclear protein profiling, nuclei isolation, and cysteine reactivity analysis.

overview_description.description: Talus Bio is a drug discovery biotech startup working on drug development for gene regulators. The company integrates functional proteomics, automated biology, and machine learning to target challenging cancer transcription factors. The MARMOT (Multiplexed Assays for the Rational Modulation Of Transcription Factors) platform, developed by the company, leverages AI, advanced proteomics, synthetic chemistry, and computational biology to design and analyze drugs, proteins, and genomics in a groundbreaking manner.
